about: Prompt templates for Lyria 3.5, one per video mood. They follow Google's Lyria prompt structure (genre and era, mood, 3 to 5 named instruments, tempo and key, timestamped sections with an intensity, an explicit ending, and 'Instrumental.' last). Written for nexa-sound; not yet tried against the live model. RealTime prompts marked derived were made from the template's genre and instruments; the others are the starting sets from the research.

placeholders.{DUR}: the video length plus 2 s of headroom, whole seconds
placeholders.{SECTIONS}: one line per section from the cut list: [m:ss - m:ss] Label: what changes. Intensity: n/10
placeholders.{DROP}: the time of the heaviest cut (the key reveal), whole seconds
placeholders.{BPM}: the tempo (the mood's default unless the brief sets one)
placeholders.{KEY}: the key (the mood's default unless the brief sets one)

moods.name: Corporate clean
moods.template: Create a {DUR}-second instrumental modern corporate pop track as background music under a voice-over. Optimistic, confident and warm. {BPM} BPM, {KEY}. Clean muted electric guitar plucks, soft felt piano, light claps, gentle kick, warm synth pad, subtle bass. Simple, sparse melody that leaves room for narration; steady energy with gentle lifts at section changes. {SECTIONS} End on a clean final chord that rings out naturally by {DUR} seconds. Polished, uncluttered mix. Instrumental.

moods.name: Tech explainer
moods.template: Create a {DUR}-second instrumental electronic tech track for an app walkthrough. Curious, focused, forward-moving. {BPM} BPM, {KEY} with bright lifts. Crisp digital plucks, arpeggiated analog synth, tight electronic drums with soft hi-hats, deep sub bass, airy pads. Rhythmic and minimal, no busy lead melody. {SECTIONS} Finish with a short filtered sweep into one final synth hit at {DUR} seconds with a short tail. Instrumental.

moods.name: Cinematic epic
moods.template: Create a {DUR}-second instrumental cinematic orchestral trailer cue. Epic, determined, rising. {BPM} BPM, {KEY}. Low string ostinato, taiko and orchestral percussion, brass swells, choir pad, deep sub hits. Quiet tension at the start, a steady build, and a massive impact at {DROP} seconds, then full orchestra. {SECTIONS} End on one huge final hit that decays naturally until {DUR} seconds. Instrumental.

moods.name: Inspirational
moods.template: Create a {DUR}-second instrumental inspirational piano and strings piece. Hopeful, heartfelt, gently uplifting. {BPM} BPM, {KEY}. A soft piano motif, warm cello, violin section swells, and a light muted pulse that joins later. Grows slowly, never loud under speech. {SECTIONS} End on a sustained major chord that rings out by {DUR} seconds. Instrumental.

moods.name: Lo-fi chill
moods.template: Create a {DUR}-second instrumental lo-fi hip hop beat. Relaxed, warm, nostalgic. {BPM} BPM, {KEY} seventh chords. Dusty swung drum break, mellow Rhodes chords, warm upright bass, soft vinyl crackle. One steady groove with consistent energy, no build-up. {SECTIONS} End with the Rhodes playing the last chord alone. Instrumental.

moods.name: Upbeat vlog
moods.template: Create a {DUR}-second instrumental sunny acoustic indie pop track. Carefree, bright, adventurous. {BPM} BPM, {KEY}. Strummed acoustic guitar, ukulele, hand claps, tambourine, bouncy bass, a catchy glockenspiel hook. {SECTIONS} End with a final strum and clap at {DUR} seconds. Instrumental.

moods.name: Energetic ad
moods.template: Create a {DUR}-second instrumental punchy electro-pop ad track. Bold, exciting, high energy from the first second. {BPM} BPM, {KEY}. Driving kick, snappy snare, bright synth stabs, pumping pads, a rising riser into a beat drop at {DROP} seconds. {SECTIONS} End on one hard final stab at {DUR} seconds. Instrumental.

moods.name: Luxury elegant
moods.template: Create a {DUR}-second instrumental minimal deep house track. Elegant, sophisticated, understated. {BPM} BPM, {KEY}. Soft kick, brushed hi-hats, round sub bass, lush Rhodes chords, subtle string pad. Smooth and restrained throughout. {SECTIONS} End with the pad and Rhodes ringing out by {DUR} seconds. Instrumental.

moods.name: Suspense
moods.template: Create a {DUR}-second instrumental dark cinematic suspense cue. Tense, mysterious, slowly rising. {BPM} BPM, {KEY}. Low drones, a pulsing synth bass, ticking percussion, distant piano notes, bowed metal textures. {SECTIONS} End on a low sustained drone that cuts to a short silence at {DUR} seconds. Instrumental.

moods.name: Playful
moods.template: Create a {DUR}-second instrumental cheerful whimsical track. Playful, bouncy, friendly. {BPM} BPM, {KEY}. Ukulele, glockenspiel, pizzicato strings, hand claps, light marimba, bouncy bass. {SECTIONS} End with a cute final glockenspiel and pizzicato hit at {DUR} seconds. Instrumental.

moods.name: Calm wellness
moods.template: Create a {DUR}-second instrumental ambient piece. Calm, spacious, soothing. Slow, around {BPM} BPM, {KEY}. Warm evolving synth pads, soft piano notes with long reverb, gentle singing bowl tones, light natural ambience; floating and percussion-free. {SECTIONS} Let the final pad fade naturally by {DUR} seconds. Instrumental.

moods.name: Bangladeshi festive or folk-fusion
moods.template: Create a {DUR}-second instrumental festive Bangladeshi folk-fusion track. Joyful, colourful, celebratory. {BPM} BPM, {KEY} with a pentatonic folk melody. Dhol and dhak rhythm, a dotara riff, ektara drone, bansuri flute lead, harmonium chords, mandira and khol percussion, with modern bass and light electronic drums underneath. {SECTIONS} End on a big dhol hit and a held harmonium chord at {DUR} seconds. Instrumental.

calm.template: Create a {DUR}-second instrumental Bengal Baul inspired acoustic folk piece. Warm and earthy. {BPM} BPM, {KEY}. Ektara and dotara, bansuri, khamak, soft tabla. {SECTIONS} End on a held dotara chord that rings out by {DUR} seconds. Instrumental.
